title: Food picture cards
subject: PSHE
source: Written for pshe/y1 lesson 6 (Food picture cards)
intro: Lesson 6: Staying healthy: food, water, sleep and moving. Listen, look, then do the tasks with a grown-up.

blocks.title: Sort into: Every day / Sometimes
blocks.task: sort them into the columns: Every day, Sometimes.
blocks.answer: Every day: Apple; Carrot; Bread; Banana. Sometimes: Sweets; Crisps

panels.title: Water and sleep
points: Water helps us think and play
Bedtime after Isha, early to rise

keywords.def: a food we have only sometimes
rest our body needs every night

questions.q: Show me: draw one healthy food on your whiteboard.
questions.a: For example: an apple, a carrot, a banana.

questions.q: Thumbs up or down: we need sleep to grow.
Core: Draw your healthy plate: three foods for every day (pupil PDF).
questions.a: A plate with three healthy foods.

questions.q: Extend: Choose one goal: drink water with every meal, or a fruit every day. Tell the class.

questions.a: B) Sweets. Sweets are fine sometimes; fruit and vegetables are for every day.

questions.q: Our body needs... A) only sweets B) food, water, sleep and moving C) only sleep
questions.a: B) food, water, sleep and moving

questions.q: Big question: what is our body's fuel?
